summary: A 236-unit affordable apartment complex (up to 60% AMI) at 420 Berry Street in Mission Bay North, next to Mission Creek Park, developed by Related Companies and Chinatown Community Development Center and designed by David Baker & Associates to follow the curve of the adjacent Caltrain tracks. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8703, lot 006) records the building's construction year as 2007.

milestones.text: Building completed, per DataSF Assessor tax roll

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (block 8703, lot 006 -- 420 Berry St)
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Office of the Assessor-Recorder

sources.title: SoCal investor buys 236-unit affordable complex in SF's Mission Bay

open_questions: Precise opening month and total development cost not found in this pass -- only a bare construction year is sourced from the Assessor's tax roll.

This record's own geometry file previously flagged the completion year as an unconfirmed 'mid-to-late 2000s' estimate; the Assessor's 2007 figure (cross-checked against a commercial property-records aggregator during this pass) resolves that to a specific, sourced year.
